label: Monday, October 26, 2026 · Fed-and-earnings week edition
intro: Five finance reads to open the week. Headlines and two-sentence takes stay here; the full articles stay with the publishers. USC students read almost all of these free through the USC Libraries.

items.title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq rise as investors parse Anthropic IPO filing, busy week of tech earnings
items.take: Stocks opened the week higher as investors parsed Anthropic's just-filed public S-1 and braced for a full earnings docket plus the Fed's decision on Wednesday. Alphabet and Microsoft report that day, with markets broadly expecting the central bank to hold rates steady days before the midterms.

items.title: Meta launches $35 billion stock offering to fund AI expansion
items.take: Meta launched public offerings of about $35 billion in common and convertible preferred stock to bankroll its AI buildout, days after a sharp earnings-driven selloff. It is the most direct test yet of whether investors will keep funding AI capex at this scale.

items.title: US stock futures edge up as oil falls heading into earnings barrage
items.take: Crude pulled back from last week's surge, lifting sentiment after two straight losing weeks on Wall Street. Elon Musk added a fresh warning: markets have "almost entirely shut off access to money" for companies without revenue independent of AI data centers, and CoreWeave and Nebius are each down more than 30% this month.

items.title: Analysts forecast Brazil market falls after Lula turnaround win
items.take: President Lula's surprise reelection over Flavio Bolsonaro is set to trigger a sharp selloff in Brazilian markets on Monday. The iShares MSCI Brazil ETF tumbled 26% premarket, which if it holds would be its biggest single-day drop since 2000.

items.title: Surveillance: Market Uncertainty Ahead of the Midterms
items.take: This morning's Bloomberg Surveillance sets up the week: a Fed decision Wednesday, tech earnings across the tape, and midterm uncertainty layered on top. Longer-form, so it pairs well with a walk to campus.
